recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, high-contrast night scene featuring two towering lattice radio masts connected by a horizontal arc of blue electricity, overlooking a glowing Art Deco structure in a misty desert basin.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between deep indigo sky and glowing cyan electricity
Geometric rigidity of the architecture versus organic mist
Verticality of towers versus horizontal desert expanse
coreInvariants: Electric arc connecting the top of two structures
Centralized glowing building with Art Deco stepped geometry
Deep blue to cyan gradient sky
Misty, low-lying fog obscuring the ground plane

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small, glowing Art Deco building is centered in the lower third; two massive towers flank the edges, reaching the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal electric bolt at the top center acts as the primary visual hook.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the electric arc, travel down the towers to the central building, and follow the road lines into the mist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of open sky in the upper-middle section create a sense of vastness.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Indigo and Cobalt Blue (Sky and Shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and Electric Blue (Lightning and Glow)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Yellow and Gold (Typography and Interior Lights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark sky and the self-illuminated elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit warm tones to small highlights

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans-Serif and Art Deco Serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Wide-tracked, bold geometric sans-serif
Central logo: Extended serifs with horizontal speed lines
Building text: Vertical stack of blocky, neon-style letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars extending from characters to form lightning-like speed lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Wide-tracked sans-serif for the header paired with a complex, illustrative logo mark in the center.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and wide stance of the top header.
Provides the sharp serif foundation for the central logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desert night landscape with two tall lattice radio towers on the far left and right. A horizontal blue electric arc connects their tips. In the center foreground, place a glowing Art Deco diner with stepped architecture and bright windows. The ground is covered in low blue mist with a faint road reflecting the light.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-tracked bold yellow sans-serif text at the top. In the upper center, place a custom logo featuring serif text integrated with horizontal speed lines and a central lightning bolt motif.

verificationChecks: Is the electricity arc horizontal and connecting the towers?
Is the central building glowing from within?
Is the sky a smooth blue gradient?
Is the typography wide-tracked and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the Art Deco building
Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or band logos
Exact character shapes of the central emblem
postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetry in tower placement
Ensure the electric arc has a bright white core and blue outer glow
Confirm the mist does not obscure the building's sharp edges
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [80s airbrush desert night] + [lattice radio towers] + [electric arc] + [Art Deco architecture] + [wide-tracked gold typography].
